comments.body: Friendly ping: this is ready for review whenever someone has a moment. Happy to adjust anything.

Confidence Score: 5/5

**[Medium impact]** This default-model change appears safe to merge.

Summary

Changes Requesty's default model from retired Claude 3.7 Sonnet to Claude Sonnet 4.6. - Requesty setups start with Claude Sonnet 4.6. Reviews (1) · Last reviewed commit: ["fix(requesty): replace retired Claude 3...."](https://github.com/cline/cline/commit/1dfe92eb7cc7aca44e530a1ca0771129356d35f4) · [Reviewed by Greptile](https://www.greptile.com/?utm_source=greptile_review&utm_medium=github&utm_campaign=review_public&utm_content=cline/cline)

Thanks for this, and for checking it against Requesty's live model list — confirmed on our side that `anthropic/claude-3-7-sonnet-latest` is gone and `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6` is listed.

Closing rather than merging because this constant isn't the Requesty default at runtime. It only seeds the picker's placeholder and one extra list entry; when no model has been chosen, the session uses the default from the SDK model catalog (`getDefaultModelIdForProvider` in `apps/vscode/src/sdk/cline-session-factory.ts`). So updating the string changes what the picker shows but not what a fresh Requesty setup sends.

The fix we want is to remove `requestyDefaultModelId` / `requestyDefaultModelInfo` and the `requesty` entry in `NON_SDK_PROVIDER_DEFAULTS` so the catalog is the single source, the same way the `cline` provider already works. That depends on first sorting out a mismatch between the catalog's Requesty model ids and the ids Requesty's API lists, so we'll handle it on our side.
